第一人稱物品互動模組！

[![Discord 伺服器](https://img.shields.io/discord/1444791753529102428?style=for-the-badge&logo=Discord&logoColor=white&label=Discord&color=728ADA)](https://discord.gg/8Ap2gGaKbw) [![YouTube 頻道訂閱者](https://img.shields.io/youtube/channel/subscribers/UCrS774u0xB1JvgphM3HRbWg?style=for-the-badge&logo=youtube&logoColor=white&label=Youtube&color=FF0034)](https://www.youtube.com/@omardotcontent) [![CurseForge 下載量](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1405017?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&logoColor=white&label=curseforge&color=F16436)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/interactivestuff) [![Modrinth 下載量](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/interactivestuff?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&label=Modrinth&color=1CD96A)](https://modrinth.com/mod/interactivestuff) [![GitHub 追隨者](https://img.shields.io/github/followers/omardotcontent?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&label=Github)](https://github.com/omardotcontent)
![描述](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e984962684598311a8697c7ffc65bf79e2d6ede_0.webp) InteractiveStuff 是一個適用於 Minecraft **1.21.10+** 的客戶端 Fabric 模組，為第一人稱視角中的物品和方塊添加了沉浸式互動行為——例如動態手持物品、反應式音符盒、伏聆振測器、燈籠等等。強烈建議使用第一人稱模式以獲得最佳體驗。 ### [Vyn](https://github.com/Abdelaziz1586/Vyn) 支援 InteractiveStuff 整合了 Vyn，讓資源包創作者能夠以任何他們想要的方式編寫物品渲染和行為腳本，無需 Java 知識。 --- ![重要提示](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d00f8ef6f1c482fbc5e2e46d7c68f293b5d3b683_0.webp)
